nom: Hero Cosmetics Rescue Patch Replenishing Cream Patches

avis.texte: I have tried so many different hydrating masks, serums...you name it. My skin is super sensitive and my skin's barrier gets damaged easily. I use this once and my skin is immediately better. I always keep a few on hand for quick skin recovery.

Idk, maybe there's a market for this, but I'm not it. I have acne all over my face, not in 3 inch patches. Two patches don't even cover all of my neck acne marks. I wish they would've just made it a sheet mask (at a more reasonable price). I like the idea, but the execution didn't work for me. If I could cover my whole face (and part of my neck) with 4 patches and the price was more like $12, I'd be more interested in using it occasionally. But instead, I'm buying a reusable sheet mask and I'll put a thick layer of the Rescue Balm cream under it. The product itself is pretty good. It stays in place pretty well even if you're doing chores or laying down. The patches do the same thing for me as the Rescue Balm cream - they help my post-acne marks heal faster and bring down the redness.

Absolutely love these patches! I've gone through about 4 boxes (which is not a lot considering each box only has 3 pairs lmao) but this has made such a difference in my skin. I dont use it often but when I feel like my skin needs some extra TLC and this makes my skin soooooo hydrated and soothed. I have oily acne prone skin, and this helps calm any breakouts I have and has been a great addition to my winter routine. Only downside is that it's expensive for what it is, but thats not a problem with the product itself. Again, each box comes with 3 pairs each which isn't a lot but its possible to stretch its use. I use them mostly on my cheeks and when they start to dry, I put them on my forehead & chin so that the majoirty of my face can get the extra moisture. Highly reccomend if you have inflammed skin you need to calm & hydrate!
